nom: COSRX Advanced Snail Mucin Gel Cleanser

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin are split: some report increased sebum or oiliness after use, while others describe it as suited to normal-to-oily skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin most often report that the cleanser hydrates and cleans without stripping or leaving a tight feeling, though one combination-dry reviewer found it drying.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers generally report it balances well without dryness or oiliness, though one reviewer with combination skin found it very drying and disrupted her makeup.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including those with eczema or psoriasis, frequently report no burning, irritation or redness, though one reviewer describes chemical burns spreading across her face.
segments.mature: A reviewer in her 40s with dryness- and redness-prone skin reports it as her favorite non-cream cleanser that doesn't strip or irritate.

concerns.aging: One reviewer combining this cleanser with other products reports her skin looks tighter, firmer and younger, though this is credited to a full routine rather than the cleanser alone.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers who mention dehydration or dryness report the cleanser hydrates and leaves skin soft without stripping; one dehydration-prone reviewer switched to a different hydration-focused line afterward and another found it too drying for her skin.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with redness report it soothes their skin without irritation, including one with psoriasis-related flare-ups and one with jawline redness and texture that improved.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe it as gentle and helpful for repairing or calming a compromised skin barrier without feeling stripped.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report improvement in dark spots, hyperpigmentation and acne scars with continued use.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are mixed: several reviewers describe clearer skin, faded breakouts, or a purging period that resolved into clear skin, while others report new breakouts, cystic-like zits, or increased oiliness triggering acne.
concerns.oiliness: Reports are mixed: some reviewers say it doesn't leave skin oily or filmy, while others with oily skin report it made their skin noticeably oilier or caused excess sebum.

aspects.libelle: Scent described as unpleasant or chemical
Risk of purging during initial use
Good value for price and quantity

extraits.titre: Be careful ( gave me chemical burns)
extraits.texte: I honestly never write reviews on anything but i feel like i have too. I feel bad about leaving a negative review because i love there other products, but this product literally gave me chemical burns on my face. It started with one little one and then it spred all over my face, i had no idea what was happening until i realized it was this product that was doing it to me. It honestly was a horrible experience. This may just be how my face reacted so just please be careful if you decide to get this.

This cleanser is way too drying for my combination skin. It gave me dry patches inbetween my eyebrows and on my cheeks, and it made my makeup separate. I typically love the cosrx snail mucin line, but the cleanser specifically I would not recommend. Only pro is that it did not make my skin breakout, so if you have very oil acne prone skin it may work for you.

extraits.titre: HG status for dry sensitive skin
extraits.texte: Everyone talks about the essence but this is my favorite from the snail line. This is the only non-cream based cleanser that works for me. I'm in my 40s and my skin very prone to dryness and redness. this cleanser doesn't strip it, the way the cosrx low pH one did, and doesn't irritate my face. It still leaves my face feeling clean, which isn't always the case with the mold lotion like cleansers.

so I have psoriasis. about two years ago I had a cancer scare and stress of it caused a flare up on my face. despite trying so many products, it just kept getting worse until I couldn't wear foundation anymore because it would look like my face was peeling right between my eyebrows. the foundation just stuck to those areas so bad. I saw a review for this line from someone who's bf had psoriasis and how it helped so I immediately bought the line and I'm so glad! I exfoliate maybe once a week with a peel, then use this every single day. as long as I keep up on using the line, I can actually wear foundation again! also, FYI, snails are a member of the mollusk family so if you're allergic to clams or oysters, don't use it. I am, but I was willing to risk the allergic reaction. thankfully my allergy isn't that severe that I can use it topically and be okay.

This cleanser is great for normal to oil skin. I would not recommend it for dry skin. I have sensitive skin that is often dehydrated and/or dry that often reacts to products easily. This product left my skin feeling clean, supple, and did not cause any adverse reactions. Also, it only takes a pea size amount so the product last a long time. Great value for the price. Chose to switch to their hydration line as i have dehydrated skin.

extraits.titre: It's better than what I used to use
extraits.texte: I was skeptical about switching to a korean brand, and this one was popping up everywhere. I struggled with mainly dark spots and acne on my cheek ( especially my right cheek) and finding a good cleanser was always a hassle. I actually bought the travel size before committing to the full size and honestly I dont regret it whatsoever, in the beginning I had purging which is normal and that alone made me want to stop but I am glad that I just sucked it up and kept using it and once the travel sizes finished I bought the full size and im really loving how my skin has turned out, I use some of their other products as well and I enjoy them very much

I have eczema, so that means I have very dry and sensitive skin. It took me a while to find the perfect cleanser. When I started using the Snail Mucin Gel Cleanser, it felt like magic! It left my skin feeling clean and moisturized. My skin didn't even get red or irritated while using it. I give this cleanser a 10/10 for people who have eczema or sensitive skin!
